evidence: 2026-10-09: real signup through the Agent Vault staging proxy (pre-approved login reebok.com, plain test-inbox address). /account/login redirected to account.reebok.com; the email token filled input[type=email]; Continue (aria-label) sent a code from support@reebok.com; the code, supplied by the account owner, signed in to the account page (Orders link present, get_session_outcome success). No captcha. A fresh session repeated the sign-in with a new code and reached the same signed-in page.
gotchas: Shopify new customer accounts: passwordless. /account/login redirects to Shopify's hosted sign-in, which asks for an email and then emails a 6-digit code; there is no password, and the same flow both creates the account and signs in.
The sign-in page also has a 'Continue with Shop' button that opens shop.app in a NEW TAB; a bare button:has-text("Continue") matches it first. Use button[aria-label="Continue"] for the email step.

The code goes into a single input[autocomplete="one-time-code"]; it signs in on fill, with no separate submit. It is valid 15 minutes and belongs to the account owner: it is supplied by the account owner.
Signed in shows the account page with an Orders link (a[href*="/orders"]).
Reebok's hosted sign-in sits on account.reebok.com (a reebok.com subdomain), so fill_login with the reebok.com login's email token works there.
